title: Hungary: Centre-right Tisza party tipped to defeat Orban's Fidesz
summary: Hungarians headed to the polls on Sunday in a pivotal parliamentary election that could end Prime Minister Viktor Orban’s 16-year grip on power, as the opposition led by Peter Magyar challenges his nationalist rule in a contest drawing scrutiny across Europe and backing for Orban from US President Donald Trump. France 24 Clovis Casali reports from Budapest.
